+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import dataclasses
+
+import pytest
+
+from orgos.agile.metrics_v2.base import Metric
+
+
+class TestMetricConstruction:
+    def test_metric_construction(self) -> None:
+        m = Metric("mean_takt", 3.5, "s")
+        assert m.name == "mean_takt"
+        assert m.value == 3.5
+        assert m.unit == "s"
+
+    def test_metric_is_frozen(self) -> None:
+        assert len(dataclasses.fields(Metric)) == 3
+        m = Metric("mean_takt", 3.5, "s")
+        with pytest.raises(dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError):
+            m.name = "other"
